title: Institutional flow intensity cross-sectional research

method.existing_rule: 4 of the latest 5 market sessions have same-sign net institutional flow and 5-session net is at least +/-100,000 shares
method.normalized_candidate: rank 5-session net shares / prior 20-session mean reported volume separately within market and signal date; top/bottom decile among same-sign 4-of-5 persistent flows
method.momentum_confirmation_candidate: split existing fixed-threshold flow signals by whether the stock's 5/20-session close-to-close return relative to its market's equal-weight return agrees with flow direction; both features are known by the next-session-open entry cutoff
method.exit: close of entry session for h1, and close of the 5th/10th session after signal for h5/h10
method.excess: stock return minus same-date equal-weight return of current-master stocks with valid open/close prices
method.flow_availability_gate: each flow record's UTC-naive DB create_time must be strictly before 09:00 Asia/Taipei on the next market session
method.price_availability_gate: signal-date and lookback prices must have UTC-naive DB create_time strictly before 09:00 Asia/Taipei on the next market session; entry/exit prices are realized outcome data
method.universe: current ES* common-equity master filtered by security listing date; delisted membership is not represented by this master
method.unit_handling: No absolute intensity cutoff is compared across markets; within-market/date ranks are invariant to a market-wide lots-vs-shares scale factor.

limitations: Uses current security master for historical dates; delisted securities and historical market membership are not reconstructed.
Legacy price returns are unadjusted for dividends, splits, and other corporate actions; no transaction costs or slippage are included.
The current-master denominator is a coverage diagnostic, not a point-in-time historical universe.
Listing dates exclude securities before listing, but this current master has no delisting dates; delisted securities and historical market transfers are not reconstructed.
create_time is DB ingestion time, not the official source publication time; historical source revisions are not versioned in this legacy table.
A within-market percentile ranking is exploratory and does not establish a tradable threshold or causal signal.
Momentum confirmation groups are descriptive subgroups with overlapping dates; they are exploratory and were not selected on an independent holdout period.
